sourceTitle: The Gipsies' Advocate Or, Observations on the Origin, Character, Manners, and Habits of the English Gipsies
description: "The Gipsies' Advocate" by James Crabb is a historical account written in the early 19th century. The author aims to shed light on the origins, characteristics, and lifestyles of the English Gipsies while advocating for a more compassionate understanding of this marginalized group.
